proposals.before: If offering prayers at the place of campaign, a double enclosure is made and the Yellow Thearch is sacrificed on bear skins.
proposals.after: If offering prayers at the place of campaign, a double enclosure is made and sacrifice is offered to the Yellow Thearch on bear skins.
proposals.reason: Chinese 祀軒轅氏 means to sacrifice to Xuanyuan/the Yellow Thearch; the current English reads as if he were the sacrificial victim.

proposals.before: The commandant kneels and places the quiver before the couch, slightly east.
proposals.after: The Imperial Ox lieutenant kneels and places the quiver before the couch, slightly east.
proposals.reason: 郎將 continues the preceding 千牛郎將 (Imperial Ox lieutenant); translating as a bare 'commandant' breaks the referent.

Literal English is ungrammatical and obscures the ritual action of bowing twice.

proposals.before: The Director of Audience leads kings, dukes, and those below and the attendant archers; all in the courtyard face north in pairs as head, twice bow, then are led out.
proposals.after: The Director of Audience leads kings, dukes, and those below and the attendant archers; all in the courtyard face north in pairs as head, bow twice, then are led out.
proposals.reason: ‘twice bow’ is unnatural English; the Chinese 再拜 means bow twice.

proposals.before: When they have gone out, the chief butcher and abstinence attendants dismember the victim's chest and dismember it west of the spirit mat, spread a mat, head to the north.
proposals.after: When they have gone out, the chief butcher and abstinence attendants split open the sacrificial animal's chest and dismember it west of the spirit mat, spread a mat, head to the north.
proposals.reason: Redundant ‘dismember … and dismember’ obscures 疈牲匈磔之 (split the chest, then dismember).

decisions.reason: s0126 以熊席祀軒轅氏 means offering sacrifice to Xuanyuan/the Yellow Thearch on bear skins; the passive ‘is sacrificed’ wrongly makes him the victim, and the proposed wording restores the recipient sense without inventing content.
Same as the idiomatic field: 祀軒轅氏 is sacrifice to the Yellow Thearch, not of him; the literal repair matches that agent–patient relation.
s0282 names 千牛郎將 among those who advance; bare 郎將 in s0283 continues that officer, so ‘commandant’ loses the referent and ‘Imperial Ox lieutenant’ restores it.
Literal field has the same continuity error: 郎將 resumes 千牛郎將 from the preceding unit, not a generic commandant.
俱再拜 means all bow twice; ‘All twice bow’ is ungrammatical English for that ritual action, and the proposed order matches the Chinese.
再拜 is bow twice; ‘twice bow’ is the same unnatural inversion fixed in s0314, and the replacement is otherwise faithful to the sentence.
弓一、矢四次之 lists one bow and four arrows next; ‘four times arrows’ misreads 矢四 as a frequency instead of a count.
Same numeral error in the literal field: 矢四 is four arrows following, not arrows done four times.
疈牲匈磔之 is split open the victim’s chest then dismember it; the doubled ‘dismember’ collapses 疈 and 磔, and the proposed wording restores both actions.
Literal field repeats the fused 疈/磔 reading; splitting open the chest then dismembering west of the spirit mat matches the Chinese sequence.
